title: The policy wiki, without the SDK

steps.title: Datasource
steps.body: Create it from code and enable it for a test group.

steps.title: First run
steps.body: Index one public page and find it in search. Then one permissioned page: check it as an allowed and a denied persona.

steps.title: Identities
steps.body: Index users, then groups including a nested group, then memberships.

steps.title: Bulk replacement
steps.body: Bulk upload 30 lab pages. Upload again with 28. Observe 2 deleted: about 7%, under the safeguard.

steps.title: Predict
steps.body: An upload of 20 of 30 would delete 33%. Predict the result and cite the rule: deletion pauses for 7 days.

footnote: The lab runs outside this package against a disposable test datasource provided by your program. Your assessor scores the lab evidence.
